decisions.reason: Verified against the native schematic, exported connectivity, and exercise requirements: R1 is a 10 kOhm resistor connected directly between /IN (pin 1) and /OUT (pin 2). With /IN held at 48 V DC and /OUT externally clamped to 0 V indefinitely, the voltage across R1 is 48 V, resulting in a continuous current of 4.8 mA and continuous power dissipation of P = 48^2 / 10000 = 2304 / 10000 = 0.2304 W (230.4 mW). This exceeds the declared 0.1 W continuous power limit by 0.1304 W (230.4% of limit). Reviewer optimist-a committed a factor-of-100 arithmetic error (calculating 0.002304 W). The singleton defect finding challenger/one is therefore accepted.
